title: Ease-it Spray for the Treatment of Fire Ant Stings
brief_summary: The application of Ease-it Spray will alleviate pain secondary to fire ant stings more quickly than placebo.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* AD soldier in US Army
* Ages 18-60
* Volunteer
* Absence of serious medical condition
* Past allergic reactions
* Asthma
* History of (h/o) IFA sting

Exclusion Criteria:

* Inability to provide informed consent
* Known h/o hymenoptera allergic reaction
* Allergy to any component of the treatments
* Inability to follow-up
* Active medical condition
* Pregnancy
